i need a command to see what python verision Im running (linux terminal)

Use one of these in a Linux terminal:

- python --version
- python -V

If your system uses python3:

- python3 --version
- python3 -V

For more detail (full version text and build info):

- python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version)'
- python3 -c 'import sys; print(sys.version)'

To see the exact interpreter path and version tuple:

- python -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable, sys.version_info)'
- python3 -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable, sys.version_info)'

If you use virtual environments or multiple installs, check which binary is being used:

- which python
- which python3

And to see which Python pip is tied to:

- pip --version
- pip3 --version

Run the commands appropriate for your setup (replace python with python3 if needed).
